# Flags in the shell command are passed to the shell as written, from the
# -shell flag, the shell variable and the S attribute alike.
mk -p 1 -shell 'sh -x' -f mkfile flag
stderr '\+ echo from-flag'

mk -p 1 -f mkfile var
stderr '\+ echo from-var'

mk -p 1 -f mkfile attr
stderr '\+ echo from-attr'

-- mkfile --
flag:V:
	echo from-flag

attr:VS"sh -x":
	echo from-attr

shell = sh -x
var:V:
	echo from-var
